idea-plugin.name: Kolesa Commit Prefixer
idea-plugin.description:
Adds the name of the current Git branch to the beginning of the commit message and warns you before committing if the message does not reference it. Standard branches (main, master, develop) are left alone.
Works in every IntelliJ Platform IDE: IntelliJ IDEA, PhpStorm, GoLand, PyCharm, WebStorm, RubyMine, CLion, RustRover and Rider.

Добавляет название текущей git-ветки в начало сообщения коммита и предупреждает перед коммитом, если ссылки на неё в сообщении нет. Стандартные ветки (main, master, develop) не трогает.
Работает во всех IDE на IntelliJ Platform: IntelliJ IDEA, PhpStorm, GoLand, PyCharm, WebStorm, RubyMine, CLion, RustRover и Rider.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
3.0.0

  • 🧩 Compatibility: supports 2023.3 and every newer build, including 2026.2. The upper bound is gone, so the plugin no longer stops working after an IDE update.
  • 🖇 Fixed: the button now works in the non-modal commit tool window, which is the default in all IDEs since 2020.3.
  • 🌿 Fixed: the branch is read through the Git plugin API instead of parsing .git/HEAD — worktrees, submodules and multi-root projects are handled correctly, and detached HEAD no longer produces garbage prefixes.
  • 🔕 Fixed: no more "Missing Issue Reference" dialog on main, master and develop — the button does not prefix those branches either.
